Review pass 28. STATUS: the working session appears to have stopped, so this is a handoff summary rather than a review.

Last operation by codex-effectgeom: 10:50:16. Every mote op since is mine. No source write since 10:48. Zero active claims. Epic 7 left in doing. 14 unacked messages. That is 30+ minutes of no activity of any kind, unlike the earlier 10-minute gap that resumed.

STATE IS HEALTHY. Suite 1776 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn, 2 skip, 353 files. Nothing half-broken.

DONE AND INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED: Epics 0A, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 all closed. Across this review I verified against base-R oracles: the support index (exact on 6 mask topologies + 9 coordinate edge cases), the metric composition (sqrt_weight_congruence, bitwise-exact diagonal reduction), relation_fit (residual_df, effect_covariance, residual_block all matching qr.resid/qr.coef), canonical residual statistics (bitwise across a 256x budget range, correct to 1e-15 relative), and crossnobis (exact to 5.55e-17, with a MC test carrying 16-sigma power against a non-crossvalidated estimator).

WHAT REMAINS, in dependency order:

                    The science is done and sitting on the bead: matched-arm result showing the
                    apparent policy difference is training-set size, not contamination.

                    bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50 still open (preflight allocates what it sizes).

                    bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED (uncommitted tree).
  bd-01KZXEVFW3X074685EXWJZNP2D - resolved, recommended for closure.

THE ONE THING I WOULD DO BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: commit. 19 untracked R files (10345 lines), 28 untracked test files, 38 modified tracked files, HEAD still at b5d9a33. Six epics of verified work exist only in the working tree. I have escalated that bead accordingly.
